hero.title: Device Physics and Reliability Across Electronic Platforms.
hero.description: I study how interfacial chemistry, defects, and electronic and ionic transport shape memory states, switching variation, and reliability. Published device and array studies test these mechanisms across several electronic platforms.

core.title: Memory Device Physics & Reliability
core.description: Investigating how interfaces, defects, and charge transport govern memory switching, variability, and long-term stability.

connected.title: Neuromorphic Devices & Array-Level Computing
connected.description: Connecting analog memory behavior with fabricated device arrays, electrical readout, and computing validation.
connected.alt: Close view of a patterned microelectronic chip

connected.title: Semiconductor Interfaces & Oxide Electronics
connected.description: Engineering molecular, thin-film, and oxide interfaces to study charge injection and device reliability.
connected.alt: Patterned sample held beside laboratory processing equipment

platform.title: Flexible, Stretchable & Optoelectronic Devices
platform.description: Examining electrical variability in printed and stretchable interconnects alongside optoelectronic device interfaces.
platform.alt: Flexible transparent circuit held between gloved hands

outlook.title: Research Outlook
outlook.headline: From Device Physics to Reliable Electronic Systems.
outlook.introduction: Future questions building on published device and array studies.

directions.title: Predictive Memory Reliability
directions.description: Can electrical noise reveal the sources of analog-memory variability before reliability degrades?

directions.title: Hardware-Aware Memory Computing
directions.description: How do device variability and read noise affect array computation, and which design choices reduce the errors?

directions.title: Integrated Semiconductor Interfaces
directions.description: How do interface defects and processing conditions control leakage and long-term stability in thin-film and capacitor devices?
